Implemented and verified invite rate limiting:

- Maximum 5 invite creations per user per rolling 60-second window.
- Independent quotas for different users.
- Quota expires at 60 seconds.
- `InviteService.create(..., user_id=...)` enforces the limiter.
- `InviteService(..., limiter=...)` supports injection.
- Blocked attempts raise `RateLimited` without storing an invite.
- Added unit and end-to-end coverage.

Validation: `python3 -m unittest -v` — all 7 tests pass. `git diff --check` also passes.
